head_commit.message:
chore(floor): reconcile the collection floor on main

verify.py --reconcile-floor measured the counts on this commit and wrote them. The
floor is an equality, so a value left behind reality is permissive by exactly the gap;
the number is only knowable on the merge result, which is why this is automated rather
than asked of each author. Raising it can only make the gate stricter -- a collection
DROP still blocks the write and fails the run.
